title: Free-energy barrier for axial racemization of phosphorodithiolated styrene 3a
difficulty_reasons: The endpoint identities are fixed, but the agent must formulate a search/optimization strategy and locate a racemization saddle rather than receiving its result-bearing geometry; frequency, connectivity and free-energy validation are coupled.

paper.title: Organocatalytic enantioselective construction of axially chiral phosphorodithiolated styrenes

data.description: 57-atom XYZ endpoint geometries for 3a and ent-3a; no result-bearing transition-state geometry is provided.

required_deliverables.description: Validated stationary-point, connectivity, free-energy barrier and interpretation results.
